trust_decision.summary: Whether an on-disk superblock read from an untrusted device/image is accepted; decided only in nilfs_sb_is_valid() (magic, s_bytes, optional CRC) with no bound on s_log_block_size, which is later used as a shift count and allocation size.

landing_point.why: Advisory title names s_log_block_size validation; the only superblock validator is nilfs_sb_is_valid() in lib/sb.c, and the fix lands there.

fix_sites.entry_point: libnilfs public API nilfs_sb_read()/nilfs_sb_write() (via __nilfs_sb_read), reached by nilfs_open() and CLI tools nilfs-tune, lscp, lssu, dumpseg, nilfs-clean, nilfs_cleanerd, nilfs-resize, chcp/mkcp/rmcp

O3_reason_to_dismiss: None applicable: all superblock reads pass through one static validator, so there is no separate route to argue away.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate block sizes 1 KiB to 64 KiB (s_log_block_size 0..6) as produced by mkfs.nilfs2 must still be accepted; an over-tight bound (e.g. only 4 KiB) breaks valid filesystems.

O6_input_shapes: s_log_block_size > 6 in secondary superblock, which is checked before the shift in nilfs_sb2_offset_is_too_small (lib/sb.c:157-158, lib/sb.c:105-107)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: nilfs_get_segment_seqnum shifts by s_log_block_size+10 and multiplies s_blocks_per_segment without the NILFS_SEG_MIN_BLOCKS check present in nilfs_get_segment (lib/nilfs.c:1020)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: A maintainer could add a second, lazily validated superblock reader in a consumer (e.g. a dumpseg/resize fast path) that re-reads the raw sb instead of calling nilfs_sb_read; real code already re-derives blkbits per call site.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: nilfs_get_layout computes blocksize from s_log_block_size directly; a planted local re-read path here would bypass nilfs_sb_is_valid
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Layout export is a lower-level public API used by nilfs-resize; adding a direct read for a different device would be plausible.

O9_family: CWE-1284 improper validation of specified quantity in on-disk metadata (shift-count UB / oversized allocation)

O10_build.toolchain: autotools (autoreconf, configure, make), gcc; needs libuuid, libmount/libblkid, optionally libselinux
O10_build.project_tests: none found in tree (no test* files); behaviour testable offline via crafted regular-file images since __nilfs_sb_read accepts S_ISREG (lib/sb.c:131-132)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add a bound in nilfs_sb_is_valid() — which is the correct and complete fix; a weaker solver might instead clamp at individual consumers (lib/nilfs.c:237, lib/nilfs.c:261) and miss the sb2 offset shift at lib/sb.c:107.

out_of_scope_notes: Other superblock fields (s_blocks_per_segment, s_nsegments, s_first_data_block) are also used unvalidated in arithmetic, e.g. lib/sb.c:105-106 and lib/nilfs.c:1153-1155; different field, not this advisory's protection.
